Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center. EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle. Quezon City http: dilg.gov.ph OPINION NO. 20 MAYOR MARIAN JUNE E. LIBANAN Municipal Mayor Municipality of Taft Province of Eastern Samar Dear Mayor Libanan: 23 APR 201b This is in reference to your letter dated 20 February 2018 informing this Department that the elected Liga ng mga Barangay (LnB) President of the Municipality of Taft has been suspended from office by the Sandiganbayan. Relative thereto, you are requesting this Department's opinion on the following queries, viz: I. Wouldit be valid for the Liga Vice President to assume the aforementioned position of the Ex Officio member of the Sanggunian? 2. Ifthe Liga VIZ? President became the LnB President, is he/she allowed to receive remuneration similar with what the former LnB President received? Foremost, it must be noted that the LnB President is only suspended from the Office. Hence, he is temporarily incapacitated to perform his duties because of legal reason. The 2010 Constitution and By-Laws of the Liga ng mga Barangay, specifically Section 2, Article VIII thereof provides: b) The Vice President. I. If for any reason, the President is unable to perform his duties, the Vice-President shall perform the duties of the President subject to the rules of succession provided in Sec. 2, Art. XII herein; Based on the above-cited provision, the Liga Vice President is duty-bound to perform the duties of the President in the event that latter is unable to perform his/her duties. In this case, since the herein vacancy is only temporary, the Liga Vice President shall only act as

Acting Liga President until the Liga President's suspension from office is lifted. As a consequence, he shall also assume the duties as ex-officio member in the Sanggunian. Relative to your query on the remuneration or salary of the Acting Liga President, we would first like to differentiate "salary" from "Representation and Transportation Allowance Basic is the rule that salary attaches to the office itself and not to the officer. What salary or emoluments that may be attached by law to a public office dQ not belong to the incumbent because of any supposed legal duty resulting upon the public to pay for the services rendered by him. On the other hand, on the issue of RATA, an employee whose position is not authorized by law to collect the same but is designated to a position vacated temporarily by the incumbent on account of his leave Of absence or other legal reasons. shall be entitled to the regular RATA of the position on reimbursable basis provided he is duly designated by the appointing authority. 1 In the herein situation, the actual discharge of the Liga Vice President of the functions and duties of the Liga President and consequently as ex-officio member in the Sanggunian of the Municipality of Taft due to the suspension of the incumbent Liga President, entitles the Acting Liga President of the RATA of the said position from the time of his actual assumption of duty, provided that said discharge of function is in accordance with the Liga ng mga Barangay Constitution and By-Laws. We hope we had addressed your concerns accordingly. Thank you. Copy furnished: Dir. Marivel C. Sacendoncillo, CESO 111 DILG Regional Office 8, Kanhuraw Hill, Tacloban City, Leyte DILG Opinion No. 54, s. 2000, 14 2000 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORI OF THE SECRETARY: AUSTERE A.
